scientific_accuracy_and_numerical_valida.notes: Independent spherical trig and aperture photometry verified. Minor deduction for literature baseline lightcurve sampling limitations.

data_authenticity_and_provenance.notes: 16 authentic Level 2 FITS products verified with SHA256 hashes. Clear labeling of literature baselines.

core_application_functionality.notes: All 6 chapters, Time Machine, Spectral Explorer, Discovery Lab, Missions, and About page verified.

security_and_abuse_protection.notes: Deductions for unvalidated caller-supplied fits_url in processing.py (SSRF risk) and unauthenticated discoveries.json storage.

data_integrity_and_persistence.notes: SQLite WAL budget service verified; Discoveries JSON lacks multi-user isolation.

ai_assistant_functionality_and_safety.notes: Groq LLM streaming, token budgeting, multi-layer rate limits, and zero key leaks verified.

performance_and_stability.notes: Ultra-smooth chapter scrolling, spacecraft WebGL stability, and sub-15ms p50 API responses verified.

google_cloud_deployment_readiness.notes: Caddy reverse proxy, systemd daemon, and production build compatibility verified.

nasa_challenge_compliance.notes: Fulfills core SPHEREx time-domain, spectral 102-band, and moving/variable star challenge goals.

critical_and_high_findings.title: Unvalidated caller-supplied fits_url passed directly to requests.get (SSRF Vector)
critical_and_high_findings.description: Endpoint _find_or_fetch_fits_for_target accepts arbitrary fits_url from user request bodies and invokes fits_service.download_fits without domain allowlisting or private IP blocking (169.254.169.254, 127.0.0.1).
critical_and_high_findings.recommendation: Restrict fits_url to allowlisted domains (*.ipac.caltech.edu, *.irsa.ipac.caltech.edu, *.nasa.gov) and reject private/loopback/metadata IP addresses.

critical_and_high_findings.title: Global Unauthenticated Shared JSON Storage for Discovery Journal
critical_and_high_findings.description: Discoveries are stored in a single shared file data/discoveries.json without user authentication or session ownership. Any visitor can read all entries and send DELETE /api/discoveries/{id} to delete any record.
critical_and_high_findings.recommendation: Migrate discovery persistence to browser localStorage or session-isolated records to ensure visitor privacy.
